title: Measure lead token cost in dollars and per-turn context instead of raw input tokens
body:
Outcome: the roadmap ranks token rows by dollar cost per merged PR and by per-turn context size, not by input tokens including cache reads.
Why: cache reads cost ~10% of input and do not count toward API input rate limits (claude-api skill, shared/prompt-caching.md), so "5.24M input tokens per merged PR, 98% cache reads" overstates cost; context size still matters for accuracy and latency. Operator request 2026-11-09.
Proof: .krn/runs/token-cost/cost.md with the rerun command; roadmap Sector plan and t-bdhn7mw cite the new numbers.
Scope: this repository.
